metadata.title: Terms & Conditions and User Agreement | Bullion Trading LLC

description: Read Bullion Trading LLC Terms & Conditions covering website use, orders, purchases, and sales. Understand policies, disclaimers, and user agreement.
text:
By using the website www.BULLIONTRADINGLLC.com and other services provided by Bullion Trading LLC including making purchases from BULLION TRADING LLC, making sales to BULLION TRADING LLC and placing orders with BULLION TRADING LLC, you are agreeing to the following terms, including, without limitation, the terms available by hyperlink (the User Agreement). These terms apply to all orders, all purchases and all sales, whether made through the website, by telephone or otherwise. Before you may place orders to purchase and/or to sell with BULLION TRADING LLC you must read and accept all of the terms in the User Agreement.
This User Agreement is effective on
October 13, 2024
, for all existing customers and all existing users of the website and will be effective, upon acceptance for all customers and all new users of the website or otherwise.
Purchases, Sales and Orders. You may make purchases, sell to and order from BULLION TRADING LLC only in accordance with the Ordering Policy and Procedures.
Disclaimers. You are subject to the Disclaimers that have been made by BULLION TRADING LLC, which BULLION TRADING LLC encourages you to access and to read carefully, and to the other Disclaimers that are contained in this User Agreement and the other policies adopted by BULLION TRADING LLC.
In addition, you represent and warrant to BULLION TRADING LLC that you have sufficient experience and knowledge to make informed decisions to purchase from and/or sell to BULLION TRADING LLC. You expressly acknowledge that you are making all of your own decisions in connection with purchases and/or sales and that BULLION TRADING LLC is not making any recommendation with respect to such purchases and/or such sales. You also expressly acknowledge that you are subject to a variety of risks, which risks are beyond the control of BULLION TRADING LLC, and you expressly acknowledge that BULLION TRADING LLC is not liable or responsible for those risks, for which you have sole responsibility. Those risks include, without limitation, risks associated with the price volatility of the products, particularly precious metals. Under certain market or other conditions (such as technological or other disruptions), you may not be able to liquidate the purchased products or, liquidate the purchased products at prices acceptable to you.
Risks. All investments involve risk – coins and bullion are no exception. The value of a bullion coin (e.g., American Eagles or Maple Leafs) is affected by many economic factors, including the current market price of bullion and the perceived scarcity of the coins and other factors. Some of these factors include the quality and current demand and general market sentiment.
Therefore, because both bullion and coins can go down as well as up in value, investing in them may not be suitable for everyone. Since all investments, including bullion and coins, can decline in value, you should understand them well, and have adequate cash reserves and disposable income before considering a bullion or coin investment.
Indemnification. You shall indemnify and hold harmless BULLION TRADING LLC and its affiliates, directors, officers and shareholders (collectively, the â€œIndemnified Partiesâ€) from and against any and all costs, damages, expenses, liabilities and obligations, including, without limitation, reasonable attorneysâ€™ fees, that the Indemnified Parties may incur as a result of, or in connection with, (a) any breach of any representation or warranty made by you to BULLION TRADING LLC or (b) your failure to comply with this User Agreement or the policies adopted by BULLION TRADING LLC.
Limitation of Liability. You are subject to the limitations of liability contained in this User Agreement, the Disclaimer and the other policies adopted by BULLION TRADING LLC.
In the event that, notwithstanding such limitations of liability, BULLION TRADING LLC is determined to be liable to you in connection with any transaction between BULLION TRADING LLC and you pursuant to this User Agreement, the liability of BULLION TRADING LLC to you shall be limited to the greater of (a) the amount, if any, that you paid in such transaction or (b) $100. BULLION TRADING LLC shall not, in any event, be liable for any consequential, exemplary or indirect damages.
Privacy. BULLION TRADING LLC has adopted the Privacy Policy, which you are encouraged to access and to read carefully.
Other Policies. BULLION TRADING LLC has adopted the Disclaimer, the Ordering Policy and Procedures and the Privacy Policy and may, from time to time, adopt other policies in connection with the website and your use of the website, as well as purchases from, and sales to, BULLION TRADING LLC. All of these policies may be amended or terminated, at any time and from time to time, by BULLION TRADING LLC and such amendments and such terminations will take effect when posted on the website.
By purchasing from, making sales to or ordering from BULLION TRADING LLC, whether by telephone, through the website or otherwise, you are subject to such policies, with which you hereby agree to comply.
Termination. BULLION TRADING LLC may terminate this User Agreement, with or without cause, at any time by written notice. The termination of this User Agreement shall not affect the rights and the obligations of BULLION TRADING LLC and you with respect to the period prior to the termination.
Default; Rights and Remedies. Upon any failure by you to comply with your obligations to BULLION TRADING LLC, BULLION TRADING LLC shall have all of the rights and the remedies available to BULLION TRADING LLC, whether at law, in equity or otherwise, including, without limitation, rights and remedies under this User Agreement. Without limiting its rights and its remedies, BULLION TRADING LLC may turn your account over to a collection agency or a lawyer for collection. No delay or failure on the part of BULLION TRADING LLC in exercising any right or any remedy shall operate as a waiver of that right or that remedy and no single or partial exercise by BULLION TRADING LLC of any right or any remedy shall preclude other or further exercise of that right or that remedy or the exercise of any other right or any other remedy.
In addition to the other rights and the other remedies available to BULLION TRADING LLC, in the event of any failure by you to comply with this User Agreement, BULLION TRADING LLC may charge the credit card on which you have provided BULLION TRADING LLC including, without limitation, any and all market losses incurred by BULLION TRADING LLC, including cancellation fees, for accepting your orders to either buy from or sell to us as a result of price and market fluctuations which you did not fulfill. You expressly authorize BULLION TRADING LLC to charge your credit card for all of such amounts.
Payment to Bullion Trading LLC must be provided using a bank wire, certified check, cashiers check, money orders or personal check.
We recommend paying by the following methods:
Orders ranging from $50 to $2,500 are recommended to be paid via any option listed above and must be received within 5 business days.
Orders ranging from $2,500.01 to $10,000 are recommended to be paid by bank wire, certified check, cashiers check, money orders or personal check and must be received within 5 business days.
Orders ranging from $10,000.01 to $25,000 are recommended to be paid by bank wire, certified check or cashiers check and also must be received within 5 business days.
Over $25,000.01 are recommended to be paid by bank wire and must be received within 3 business days.
If using a credit card you are agreeing to the following terms.
I understand and agree that should I dispute the credit card charge through my credit card provider, it will constitute a breach of contract as well as credit card fraud.
I waive any charge-back rights. In the event of a dispute, requests for refund(s) must be made under the Bullion Trading LLC Arbitration described herein under Bullion Trading LLC
Dispute resolution: I understand that all sales are final. And that there are NO EXCHANGES or REFUNDS.
I understand that no circumstances can a refund be issued.
I cannot receive a refund from Bullion Trading LLC, nor can I request a chargeback from my credit card company.
I also agree to waive any charge-back rights in the event of a dispute.
Our Market Loss Policy.
As mentioned before, once we have issued a confirmation number, the price is locked in and the transaction may not be canceled, but only offset at our current ask price. Any deficit between the price at which we sold to you and the offsetting purchase price and/or prices, is your responsibility only if your item(s) is canceled or returned. If that happens, that deficit amount will be charged to you, plus a $35.00 cancellation fee. That is our Market Loss Policy. Any market gain on cancellations shall remain the property of Bullion Trading LLC.
When selling to Bullion Trading LLC, the price will be locked in for you once we have issued a confirmation number. The transaction may not be canceled, but only offset at our current buy price. Any deficit between the price at which we bought from you and the offsetting purchase price and/or prices is your responsibility if we do not receive your items. That amount will be charged to you, plus a $35.00 cancellation fee. That is our Market Loss Policy. Any market gain on cancellations shall remain the property of Bullion Trading LLC. We reserve the right to refuse an order when the confirmed price is incorrect, due to computer-related problems, pricing error, incorrect item descriptions or sudden movements in the precious metals market. Furthermore, we reserve the right to refuse or cancel any order deemed questionable, suspicious, or of significant risk to Bullion Trading LLC.
In addition to the other rights and remedies available to BULLION TRADING LLC, BULLION TRADING LLC may, without limiting its other rights and remedies, apply any of your funds in its possession to pay your monetary obligations to BULLION TRADING LLC and may offset any monetary obligations that BULLION TRADING LLC has to you against your monetary obligations to BULLION TRADING LLC. BULLION TRADING LLC may, at its discretion, apply funds in its possession, including, without limitation, amounts paid by you for other purchases or amounts payable by you for sales, to your obligations to BULLION TRADING LLC in such manner as BULLION TRADING LLC determines to be appropriate.
Absence of Relationship. The sole relationship between BULLION TRADING LLC and you is a purchaser-seller relationship. No other relationship, including, without limitation, any agent-principal relationship, any employee-employer relationship, any franchisee-franchisor relationship, any joint venture relationship or any partnership relationship, between BULLION TRADING LLC and you exists.
Assignment. You may not assign this User Agreement or any of your rights or your obligations under this User Agreement without the prior written consent of BULLION TRADING LLC, which may be granted or withheld by BULLION TRADING LLC in its sole discretion. This User Agreement shall be binding on all permitted assigns and successors of BULLION TRADING LLC and you.
Costs and Expenses of Collection. In the event that BULLION TRADING LLC must take any action against you to enforce your obligations under this User Agreement, including, without limitation, turning your account over to a collection agency or a lawyer for collection, you shall pay all of the costs and the expenses incurred by BULLION TRADING LLC, including, without limitation, reasonable attorney’s fees, in connection with such action.
Dispute Resolution. It is the common goal of BULLION TRADING LLC and you that any disagreement or dispute between BULLION TRADING LLC and you be resolved expeditiously. BULLION TRADING LLC and you agree that all disagreements and disputes between BULLION TRADING LLC and you be resolved in accordance with the following paragraphs:
Forum Selection. The federal and state courts located in the City and State of New York, shall have exclusive jurisdiction of all disagreements and all disputes. All disagreements and all disputes shall be resolved exclusively in such federal and state courts. You hereby consent to the personal jurisdiction of those federal and state courts for the purpose of resolving such disagreements and such disputes and waive all objections to the jurisdiction of such federal and state courts. Further, you agree that legal process may be served by certified or registered mail, return receipt requested, in addition to methods of service prescribed by applicable statutes.
Governing Law. This User Agreement shall be governed by, and interpreted in accordance with, the laws of the State of New York, without regard to conflict of laws principles.
Waiver of Jury Trial; Arbitration. BOTH BULLION TRADING LLC AND YOU HEREBY WAIVE THEIR RIGHT TO TRIAL BY JURY IN CONNECTION WITH ANY DISAGREEMENT OR DISPUTE RESULTING FROM, OR IN CONNECTION, THIS USER AGREEMENT AND THE TRANSACTIONS UNDER THIS USER AGREEMENT. Both BULLION TRADING LLC and you also waive any arbitration requirements to which they might otherwise be subject.
Force Majeure. If BULLION TRADING LLC cannot perform any obligation hereunder as a result of any event that is beyond its control, BULLION TRADING LLCâ€™s delay or failure to perform such obligation shall be excused and BULLION TRADING LLC shall not be liable for any damages as a result of, or in connection with, such delay or such failure.
Further Assurances. You shall execute and deliver such other documents and take such other actions as may be reasonably requested by BULLION TRADING LLC to carry out this User Agreement.
Notices. Except as otherwise provided in this User Agreement, all notices and other communications to BULLION TRADING LLC shall be directed to it at 20 West 47th Street Lower Level #24, New York, NY 10036, and all notices and other communications to you shall be directed, at the option of BULLION TRADING LLC, to the address that you provided to BULLION TRADING LLC at the time of your registration or to the email address that you provided to BULLION TRADING LLC at the time of your registration.
Recording of Phone Conversations. BULLION TRADING LLC may record phone conversations between BULLION TRADING LLC and you. You consent to the recording of such phone conversations.
Absence of Waivers. A decision or a failure by BULLION TRADING LLC to take action with respect to any non-compliance with this User Agreement does not affect the ability of BULLION TRADING LLC with respect to any other non-compliance with this User Agreement, whether of a similar or dissimilar nature.

not
indicative of future returns. This is
why
we encourage
you
to read
Our Terms and Conditions
carefully before making purchases, selling, or placing orders with
BULLIONTRADING LLC
. Refer to
Safety Tips from the CFTC
(Commodity Future Trading Commission). These terms and conditions apply to all orders, all purchases, and all sales made through our website, telephone, or other channels.
In the event you do not fully understand the terms of this agreement, BULLIONTRADING LLC strongly encourages you to consult with your own experts. BULLION TRADING enters into transactions with customers on the reliance and belief that clients are aware of, understand, and agree to these terms.
These terms and conditions are effective as of
March 11, 2022,
and are binding to all new and existing customers and users.
Risk Acknowledgment
You acknowledge that market prices for precious metals are volatile and influenced by many factors. BULLIONTRADING LLC is not responsible for any losses due to market fluctuations. You agree to make all purchase or sale decisions independently.
Order Process
BULLIONTRADING LLC does not speculate on metal prices but earns through premium spreads. Orders can be made through our website, phone, or other suitable channels. Note that once an order is placed, the price is locked and the product is considered sold.
Fraud Prevention
We reserve the right, but are not obligated, to report and prosecute actual and suspected fraud. We may require additional verification of your order, which may include a telephone confirmation or an email request for further information. In cases of suspected fraud, we reserve the right to cancel or delay orders and to cooperate with law enforcement in any resulting fraud investigations.
Inquiries
Inquiries are made by customers who are
not
ready to transact immediately. Customers can contact us or go online at
Bulliontradingllc.com
to get current market prices. The price quote and quantity available are subject to change. They can also contact us for guidance on buying and selling bullion coins and bars. You should
note
that the
Price Quotations
you receive when inquiring are
Estimates
because the prices of bullion coins and bars fluctuate daily, and the number of our stock changes all the time.
For example, The U.S Mint sets premium and minimum prices for American Eagles. Prices for American Eagles are determined by the current price of gold, silver, platinum, or palladium. The mint also charges a modest premium to cater to the cost of distribution and marketing. Consequently, the price of bullion coins and bars changes daily as the markets for gold, silver, platinum, and palladium fluctuates. Refer to the
United States Mint’s Charges for Authorized Dealers.
ORDERS
Orders are made when customers are
ready
to transact immediately. The prices you get when ordering bullion coins and bars from us are an accurate reflection of the current market prices.
Note
that once you place an order, the prices are
locked
and are no longer subject to market conditions.
An order is placed when you finalized negotiations with our agents and an invoice is generated,
not
when the payment is made. Ordering and then bailing out or canceling after an invoice is generated makes BULLIONTRADING LLC incur losses. We incur losses because when you place an order, we consider the bullion coin or bar sold and will have hedged ourselves accordingly.
Disclaimer:
To protect our company from losses, BULLIONTRADING LLC has implemented a
Market Loss Policy
.
Market Loss Policy Explained
An order starts when you finalize the deal with our agents,
not
when the payment is made. We generate an invoice immediately the deal is sealed either through our website or phone. We also count the bullion coin or bar as sold and will have hedged ourselves accordingly.
Customers who place orders, have invoices generated, and then cancel thereafter make us incur losses. To protect ourselves we have implemented a
market loss policy
. This means that you will incur penalties for ordering, having an invoice generated, and then bailing out. Once an order is placed, prices are
locked
and not subject to market conditions.
The moment you place an order an invoice is generated. If you cancel, and then gold prices decline you make us incur a loss. It is your responsibility to offset this loss if your order is canceled and your funds are returned. If this happens you will pay for the loss caused by a decline in the price of gold after a sale is made plus a cancellation fee of $35.00. This is our market loss policy.
To remain transparent and protect ourselves from risk we might require credit card information from every customer even if payment will be received through a different channel. We also will ask for immediate confirmation of the amount locked in. This gives us an avenue to compensate ourselves for losses in the event a customer places an order and then fails to pay.
However, if the price of bullion coins and bars stays the same, we usually don’t enforce our market loss policy because we don’t incur losses. If the price goes down we charge a market loss fee which is equal to the amount BULLIONTRADING LLC would have lost because of the unpaid order.
Payment Options
Bullion Trading LLC accepts payments in a variety of forms, including PayPal, credit/debit card, bank wire, personal/certified/cashier’s check, and online bill payment in check form. For orders over $5,000, bank wire is the recommended method of payment. Bullion Trading LLC does not accept cash on delivery. It is important to note that payment must be received within 5 business days in order to guarantee the locked-in price. If payment is not received within 5 days, Bullion Trading LLC reserves the right to cancel the order. A $30 late payment fee will be applied if we choose to accept your late payment. Before shipping out items, Bullion Trading LLC reserves the right to hold them for up to ten (10) business days while personal checks, certified checks, cashier’s checks, or online bill payments in check form are cleared. When a paper check payment bounces, you must resend it to us with a $30 bounced check fee applied to the original amount. Bullion Trading LLC also reserves the right to cancel the order, charge cancellation costs, or charge the outstanding balance to the credit or debit card on file.
Cancellation Policy
All sales of gold, silver, platinum, and palladium bullion are final due to the bullion market’s volatility. Once the order is submitted and confirmed, the customer enters into a legally binding contract and cannot change or cancel their order later. If the customer still insists on canceling after the order has been placed, the 10% deposit retained for check or wire orders WILL BE COLLECTED. The consumer will receive a refund for the remaining 90% of their purchase, less a 10% fee, if they paid with a credit card or PayPal.
Documentation
Bullion Trading LLC reserves the right to request additional information in support of any order, even those paid for using a credit card. Regardless of the payment method and price confirmation, Bullion Trading LLC expressly reserves the right to accept or reject any order for any reason at its sole discretion.
Return Policy
All of the products we sell at Bullion Trading LLC come with a refund, return, or exchange policy for all of our clients. The right is only valid for a period of seven (7) days after the customer receives the products from us. Within seven (7) business days of receiving the item, you must contact the customer service department of Bullion Trading LLC at
[email protected]
. At that point, you must follow the instructions given to you. The costs of shipping and handling are not refundable. All taxes, as well as return shipping and handling charges, are entirely your responsibility. Any product that is exchanged or returned but is not reasonably in compliance with these terms may be rejected by Bullion Trading LLC. If a customer requests an exchange for an item, Bullion Trading LLC expressly maintains the right, in its sole and unrestricted discretion, to either find an acceptable substitute or refund your money if one is not available. In its sole discretion, Bullion Trading LLC maintains the right to reject any refunds or exchanges that don’t meet the required criteria.
For all orders that are returned, Bullion Trading LLC charges a restocking fee equal to 10% of the total purchase price. Additionally, Bullion Trading LLC has the right to charge the customer additional market loss penalties when returning bullion products. If market gains are made on a refund, Bullion Trading LLC will continue to own those gains.
Shipping
At Bullion Trading LLC, we exclusively use FedEx for the delivery of all orders to ensure the security and efficiency of shipping. For the protection of our customers and to prevent fraud, first-time purchasers paying by credit card, as well as orders that are flagged for potential fraud, will be shipped to the nearest FedEx location for personal pickup.
Upon shipment, customers will receive an email containing a tracking number, allowing for real-time monitoring of the delivery. Our shipments are packaged discreetly, without revealing the nature of the contents, to further safeguard your purchase.
We fully insure each package until it is delivered. Our liability for the package ends once FedEx confirms delivery. Should you instruct FedEx to leave the package without a signature or with a third party, please be aware that this may invalidate the insurance coverage.
We ship exclusively within the United States and require accurate billing and shipping addresses to process your order. We are not responsible for misdelivery due to incorrect address information provided by the customer.
In the rare event that a package is lost in transit, we will take full responsibility, initiating a claim with the insurance provider and deciding, at our discretion, whether to reship your order or issue a refund.
Please be advised that any damages or theft occurring after FedEx’s confirmed delivery will not be covered by our insurance. Customers are discouraged from requesting FedEx to leave packages without a signature or with a third party, as it increases the risk of loss or theft for which we cannot assume liability.
Pricing and Information Accuracy
All prices are in US dollars and subject to change. We endeavor to ensure accuracy but reserve the right to cancel orders due to pricing errors.
Content Of Website
The information on this website is only meant to be used for informational purposes. On occasion, information on the website may be inaccurate or miss information that relates to pricing, availability, or product descriptions. Although Bullion Trading makes every effort to assure the accuracy of all the content on the site, it is ultimately your responsibility to evaluate the accuracy of all the information.
Payment Method Options
We offer a variety of payment options. To ensure that all orders are handled properly, please be sure to read and agree to all of the terms of your preferred payment method.
Credit Cards
We accept Visa, MasterCard, and Discover for all approved payment methods. For security, credit card information is not stored electronically. Orders can only be processed if the billing and shipping addresses match.
Please complete the order using the check or wire, or another shipping address if you’d prefer your package delivered to a different location. When making a purchase on BullionTradingLLC.com with a credit card, in-store pickups are not allowed.
Paypal
PayPal is accepted for transactions up to $5,000. The billing and shipping addresses must be confirmed for all PayPal orders.
When making a purchase on BullionTradingLLC.com using Paypal, in-store pickups are not allowed.
Wire Transfer
Wire transfers are accepted for purchases over $1,000 only. A 4% reduction from the item’s full price is applied when paying with a wire or a check. For wire transfer orders placed online, the maximum transaction value is $500,000. All wire transfer purchases require a 10% credit card deposit. The shipping address for the transaction and the credit card deposit must match. The deposit must be paid with one of the acceptable credit cards indicated above in order to lock in the pricing (it is not refundable in the event that the buyer cancels the transaction). After placing the order for a wire transfer, it must be received within three (3) business days. Bullion Trading LLC reserves the right to forfeit the 10% deposit, and your order and price lock-in will be canceled, if wire payment is not received within three (3) business days of the order being made. The customer will be responsible for any additional losses resulting from nonpayment that surpass the 10% deposit, and any associated costs will be charged to the credit card that was kept on file for the deposit. The account holder’s name and the name of the person receiving the package at the shipping address
MUST BE THE SAME
. The order may be canceled if the name does not match and we need more information to authenticate your account. International wire transfer payments are not accepted since the Anti-Money Laundering Compliance Program forbids the receipt of funds from outside the US. A payment submitted by an international wire transfer will be refused and returned to the sender. Please be aware that ACH transfers are not wire transfers and cannot be used to pay for wire services.
All orders will receive a wire transfer discount, which will be reflected in your cart’s final price when you check out. We retain the right to decline the wire discount in certain situations, and some items are not eligible for wire discounts.
Checks
All orders paid for using a personal, bank, or cashier’s checks, as well as online bill payments in check form, have a minimum of $1000 and a maximum of $250,000. The price of the item is reduced by 4% when paid for with one of the aforementioned checks. All check order entries will be subject to a 10% temporary deposit using a valid credit card, which will be released once full payment is received and cleared. The order will be canceled and the 10% deposit lost if the check payment is not received within 10 days of the order date. We are aware that normal mail delivery of checks may take up to a week. However, we ask that customers get in touch with us and let us know if there is a delay in mailing the check or if it takes longer to arrive than expected. The customer will be responsible for any further losses resulting from nonpayment that surpass the 10% deposit, and those losses will be charged to the credit card that was kept on file for the deposit. Note that we do not accept money orders as a form of payment. Customers can be asked to produce more proof of their identification.
Personal, bank, and cashier’s checks, as well as online bill payments made in check form, can cause a 5–10 business day shipping delay until the payment has cleared completely. All checks are held for up to 10 business days after they are received in order to ensure that they have cleared before the order is sent.
Payment in the form of a check must be mailed no later than two (2) business days after your order is submitted for all personal, bank, and cashier’s checks, as well as online bill payments.
Cash advance checks and checks tied to credit cards are not accepted.
CONSENT

You openly acknowledge that you are making all of your decisions in connection with purchases and/or sales. BULLION TRADING LLC is not making any decision on your behalf concerning purchases and sales.
You also openly acknowledge that you are subject to a variety of risks that are beyond the control of BULLION TRADING LLC. You openly acknowledge that BULLION TRADING LLC is not liable or responsible for the risks you incur while trading with us. Those risks include, without limitation, risks associated with the price volatility of bullion coins and bars. Market conditions or other disruptions such as technical problems may make it impossible for you to liquidate bullion coins and bars bought from us. You have the freedom to liquid the coins and bars at market prices acceptable to you.
RISKS
All investments involve risk – bullion coins and bars are no exception. The value of bullion coins (e.g., American Eagles or Maple Leafs) is affected by many economic factors. The current market price of bullion coins and bars is determined by perceived scarcity and other factors. Some of these factors include quality, current demand, and general market sentiment.
The price of bullion coins and bars keeps on fluctuating and this means that they are not a suitable investment for everyone. Since all investments, including bullion coins and bars, can decline in value, you should make an informed decision. It is a good idea to have adequate cash reserves and disposable income before investing in bullion coins and bars.
INDEMNIFICATION
You shall indemnify and absolve BULLION TRADING LLC and its affiliates, directors, officers, and shareholders collectively. may incur as a result of, or in connection with:
(a) Any breach of any representation or warranty made by you to BULLION TRADING LLC or,
(b) Failure to comply with these terms and conditions or the policies adopted by BULLION TRADING LLC.
LIMITATION OF LIABILITY
You acknowledge that you are subject to the limitations of liability contained in these terms and conditions, the disclaimer, and other policies adopted by BULLION TRADING LLC
.
If you suffer indirect, punitive, or speculative damages BULLION TRADING LLC is
not
liable to you. Any transaction between us and you pursuant to these terms and conditions, and any liability of BULLION TRADING LLC to you shall be limited to:
(a) The amount, if any, that you paid in such transaction or,
(b) $100 compensation. We are not, in any event, liable for any indirect, punitive, or speculative damages.
Privacy and Information Security
Bullion Trading LLC is committed to maintaining the privacy and protection of your personal information. Within the scope of our business operations and in alignment with our goal to serve you better, we may utilize your name and email address as part of our internal customer collection system. This allows us to analyze order history and customer behavior to improve our services and tailor our offerings to better meet your needs.
This utilization of information is conducted with the utmost respect for your privacy and is designed to enhance your experience with Bullion Trading LLC. We assure you that this process is managed with rigorous security measures and confidentiality protocols to safeguard your personal data. By engaging with our services, you grant Bullion Trading LLC the right to responsibly use select information such as your name, email, and order history in a manner that benefits both you as our customer and the ongoing development of Bullion Trading LLC’s service excellence.
DEFAULT RIGHTS AND REMEDIES
Upon any failure by you to comply with your obligations to BULLION TRADING LLC
,
the company shall pursue the rights and the remedies available to us. Either by law, through equity, or otherwise. It includes without limitation rights and remedies under these terms and conditions.
Breaching our rights may make BULLION TRADING LLC turn your account over to a collection agency, or a lawyer for collection. BULLION TRADING LLC will not fail in exercising any rights or pursuing any remedies in the case we suffer losses or damages.
Note: Failure by you to comply with these terms and conditions, may make BULLION TRADING LLC charge the credit card on which you have provided. This includes without limitation any and all market losses incurred by BULLION TRADING LLC, including cancellation fees, for ordering and then canceling at the last minute. You openly authorize BULLION TRADING LLC to charge your credit card for all losses caused by you violating our ordering policy.
RELATIONSHIPS
BULLION TRADING LLC is an authorized dealer and a professional organization. We maintain a professional relationship with all our clients. We
don’t
enter into relationships such as agent-principal relationships, employee-employer relationships, franchisee-franchisor relationships, joint venture relationships, and partnership relationships with our clients.
ANNULMENT
You
cannot
forfeit these terms and conditions, your rights, or your obligations as they apply without the prior written consent from BULLION TRADING LLC. You may be granted permission to forfeit your rights or it may be withheld by BULLION TRADING LLC at its sole discretion. These terms and conditions shall be binding to all parties that trade with BULLION TRADING LLC.
COSTS AND EXPENSES FOR COLLECTION
